newsitem.title: USA: Johnson & Johnson tax rate, forex hurts Q4.
newsitem.headline: Johnson & Johnson tax rate, forex hurts Q4.

text.p: Johnson & Johnson, which reported higher sales and earnings for the fourth quarter and 1996 compared to the year before, said on Tuesday that these results were achieved despite unfavorable currency translation and a higher tax rate.
"We were able to achieve these results despite intense competition, unfavorable currency translation and a higher effective tax rate," the company said in a press release.
Johnson & Johnson reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.42 a share on total sales of $5.5 billion, compared to $0.36 a share on sales of $4.8 billion the previous fourth quarter.
The company earned $2.17 a share on sales of $21.6 billion in 1996 and $1.86 a share on sales of $18.8 billion in 1995.
